correctness.rationale: Deleting target terminal vertex k makes a weighted path. Gambler-ruin electrical resistance proportions and strong Markov conditioning prove the exact terminal-law formula with two harmonic fractions. Its derivative at uniform resistances along sum r_j=n is ((n-k)h_{k-1}+k h_k)/(n-1)^2, whose one-dimensional kernel is h_j=(-1)^j binom(n-1,j) and rank n-2. Analytic submersion gives a locally onto last-vertex probability map with one-dimensional fair and nearby inverse fibers. Direct n=4 algebra gives (a,2d-a,2a-d,d) with a/2<d<2a, and comparing two adjacent starting sites for any k proves all-start uniformity forces equal resistances. Independently verified symbolic Jacobian and binomial kernel for n=3..8; finite checks support the all-n analytic argument.
